summary: Xos, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to register an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $8,779,902 of its common stock through Roth Capital Partners as sales agent. The filing is a standard shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5), not a special situation. Shares will be sold at market prices with a 3.0% commission. There are no premium, fixed price, or special terms. No board recommendation or advisor is named for a strategic event. The disclosure is routine capital-raising, not an acquisition, divestiture, tender, or restructuring. No regulatory clock or deal mechanics apply. This is a standard equity distribution, not a special event.
